scenario: An operator asks whether a live order-status agent is safe to leave running. The review finds no error budget with a window and no burn-rate alert recipient, returns HOLD, and names the error budget and the alert recipient with 05-error-budget-and-burn-alerting as the skill that produces each.

A graded error rate is quoted with no sample size behind it. The review marks the budget-with-sample-size item missing, names the sample size and sends it to 04-accuracy-sampling-plan, and returns HOLD.

The surface is live, so the route starts with measurement: 04-accuracy-sampling-plan and 05-error-budget-and-burn-alerting come before scope and inputs, because a live agent is answering customers now.
No answer surface exists yet. The route starts at 01-answer-surface-definition and 02-input-exposure-inventory so scope and input owners are settled before anything is measured.

The operator runs a commerce storefront. The review delegates catalogue, feed, policy and protocol readiness to agentic-commerce-skills with answered_here false, adds nothing about them to the missing list, and states that its decision covers answer reliability only.
All four retrieval items are present with evidence and real contract fields, nothing is missing, the accuracy owner is a named person, and the guardrails are clear, so the review returns READY.

The accuracy owner is recorded as 'the support team'. The review lists accuracy_owner as missing, sends it to 06-accuracy-ownership-separation, and returns HOLD even though the four retrieval items are present.
The review returns READY while the accuracy owner field says 'the support team', on the grounds that someone is clearly responsible.
The review counts the alert recipient item as present because burn-rate alerts go to a shared support queue, and returns READY.
The review counts the error budget item as present because the operator's budget is zero percent wrong answers, and returns READY.
The review marks the budget item present from the number of support tickets last month, with no graded sample and no sample size behind it.
The accuracy owner and the coverage owner are the same person, and the review returns READY because both roles are filled.
To clear a HOLD, the review edits the live agent's abstention threshold and re-enables the surface itself instead of recommending the change to the accuracy owner.
The review pastes a sampled customer's email address and order number into its evidence field to show the retrieval test was run.
